main_text.p: tum afflixerit : Execrantur sacrilegum transfugam, nec jam amplius inter suos numerant , qui sub Christi fignis non cenferetur : Tota jam iis profapiæ fpes in Davide suo , natu minore recumbit: Cui proinde principem & leétissimam virginem desponsant, nomine Catharinam : Quæ & filium ei peperit , qui vocatus est Tamaras Myrsa: Hunc Myrsam, tenerum adhuc ( quod videretur hæres regni, exclufo Constantino ad Davidem jam devoluti ) etiam depofcit Persarum Rex in fidei obsidem , & quia non tutum videbatur tergiversari , confestim mittitur. Myrsam ad se delatum, Rex iisdem aggreditur blanditiis, quibus antè Patruum ejus Constantinum pellexerat in suam se-ctam; Necquidquam: Nam adversus nefandæ Sirenis cantum, nimis

page.notes: The catchword "altè" stands at the lower right, below the last line. The word "se-ctam" is split at the line end with a printed hyphen; the second part reads as "ctam" in a ligature-like form, which is doubtful. The left strip shows show-through and the facing page only.
